legend-nilgiri-mountain-road.story: curated scenic road. tea hills, forest, wildlife. 130 km from Mysore to Wellington, about 2 h 22 of riding. The stops in between: Masinigudi, Naduvattam and Ooty. The highest point is about 1,700 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Nilgiri Mountain Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 24 km this is Nilgiri Mountain Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
